in_sanskrit.name: मयाधर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: मया (Maya) + धर (to hold, bear) = मयाधर (Beloved by Maya)

in_hindi.name: मयाधर
in_hindi.long_meaning: माया (Maya) + धरना (to bear, hold) = मयाधर (Beloved by Maya)

in_marathi.name: Mayadhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayadhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayadhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ma' meaning 'great' and 'yas' meaning 'power'. The name is often given to a child believed to have great potential and the power to overcome challenges.
